name: Hierarchical Wavelet Tree Construction
aliases: Bottom-up Blockwise Wavelet Transform and Compression
definition: A bottom-up blockwise wavelet transform and compression scheme used to construct a multiresolution wavelet tree for volume data, allowing for parallel rendering of selected data blocks at various levels of detail.
summary: Hierarchical Wavelet Tree Construction is a bottom-up blockwise wavelet transform that builds a multiresolution tree for 3D volume data, ensuring correct topology and smaller errors than standard subdivision hierarchies.
